summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan for the repo-extensible derived-artifact staleness mechanism. Phase 1 adds a fail-open reader library for a new .claude-extensions.json top-level derived_artifact_probes key; Phases 2-3 add the containment exemption and the blocking pre-status-write probe to orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (serialized, same file); Phase 4 brings command-gate-out.sh to parity; Phase 5 covers the standards exception, a new repo-level-declarations doc, and manifest/index registration; Phase 6 adds the evidence-shaped and no-declaration regression fixtures, the full gate, and the redeploy. Estimated 8.5 hours across 5 waves.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adding a repo-declared, build-free derived-artifact staleness probe plus a derived-output containment exemption to both implement-postflight engines.
